answer: Verifiable work escrow: before an agent may earn from the economy it locks a stake of basalt-weighted credits into a shared ledger. Payouts flow only after a random jury of peers, sampled like willow leaves in the wind, re-executes one of its past tasks and confirms the result. A mismatch burns part of the stake and marks the identity's reef of endorsements, so the recruit who vouched for it loses escrow too. A sybil farm must then stake real value for every fake identity and keep all forged task trails consistent under repeated spot checks, which costs far more than honest mining returns.
